page.layout: One page of text: verse lines, running head at top left, page number at top right. Signature at lower right of the text.

main_text.l: Num ciues crebris attritos cladibus ista Exhauri-
Francisci frustra mens canit prouida regis
O mala quanta ferent! audaces funera
Non patria flammas, Helenē cum duxit
Hæc memores olim prædicta renoluite, Galli,
Et vestris tandem satiati cladibus, atque
Non fraude, ast Francum vera virtute,
Magnates veterum cretos de sanguine Regum,
Gallos Gallus amat pro rege perire paratus,
Ad fines verum si spes deducet auara Vestros vagantes

page.notes: The line "Non dedit Ausoniæ graniora incommoda dirus" is uncertain at "graniora"; it may be "graviora". The signature "C. iiij." is read with doubt at the final letters. The word "Helenē" carries a tilde over the final e as printed.
